payload.note: Contract-documentation request for the v26.9.25 direct WSS transport. The client dials XAAS_TUNNEL_URL (ws:// or wss://, XAAS_TUNNEL_TOKEN bearer in the RFC 6455 upgrade handshake) and speaks the bounded trio (fabric.probe, run.submit, epoch.receipts) as one tunnel envelope per request: -> {"v":1,"kind":"http","method","path","headers","body"} <- {"v":1,"kind":"http_response","status","body"}. The probe -> admit -> submit -> execute -> sealedReceipt -> replay sequence is unchanged from the HTTP surface; only the wire changes. Generic MCP and actuate are refused client-side (REFUSED_REQUEST[TRIO_ONLY_TRANSPORT]) before any dial.
